title: Hom into an essentially constant ind-system value is the colimit of Hom sets
statement: Let $J$ be a filtered category, $\mathcal C$ a category, and $F:J\to\mathcal C$ a diagram that is essentially constant as an ind-object with value $X$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. For every object $Y$ of $\mathcal C$, the canonical map $\varinjlim_{j\in J}\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(Y,F(j))\to\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal C}(Y,X)$ induced by the essential-constancy isomorphisms is a bijection.
